mapper.select: SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.TERM TERM, A.PFLSH PFLSH, A.PFLSH_NAME pflshName, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.CREDIT_FLAG as creditFlag, A.REMARK, A.CREDIT_CONDITION FROM CREDIT_LINES A where SEQNO = #{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, CONCAT(a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,CONCAT(':' ,a.FINPROD_ABBR)) text FROM FIN_PRODUCT a inner join fin_product_type b on a.finprod_id=b.finprod_id
b.TYPE_8 is not null AND a.FINPROD_TYPE2 not in ('F01','F06','F10')
AND (a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR a.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )

SELECT m.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, n.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, m.INSTITUTION_CODE as institution_Code FROM CREDIT_LINES m left join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL n on m.CUSTOMER_ID=n.SEQNO where m.CUSTOMER_ID in (select SEQNO from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL where FINPROD_ID=#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) union all select sdpm.BUSINESS_DATA_PK2 as customerId, n.ASSETPOOL_NAME as customerName, sdpm.BUSINESS_DATA_PK5 as institution_Code from SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK sdpm left join CREDIT_ASSETPOOL n on sdpm.BUSINESS_DATA_PK2 = n.SEQNO WHERE sdpm.BUSINESS_DATA_PK2 in (select SEQNO from CREDIT_ASSETPOOL_DETAIL where FINPROD_ID=#{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) and sdpm.BUSINESS_DATA_PK6 = '0003' AND sdpm.status IN('A','U','P') and sdpm.his_no = (select max (sdpm1.his_no) from SYS_DATA_PROCESS_MARK sdpm1 where sdpm1.WORKFLOW_ID = sdpm.WORKFLOW_ID)

SELECT a.FINPROD_ID id, CONCAT(a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,CONCAT(':' ,a.FINPROD_ABBR)) text FROM FIN_PRODUCT a inner join fin_product_type b on a.finprod_id=b.finprod_id
b.TYPE_8 is not null AND a.FINPROD_TYPE2 in ('F01','F06','F10')
AND (a.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') OR a.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%', #{finprodMarketId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%') )
